raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Reference out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2's 80×40 grid with h2=0.25 determines a 20×10 in-plane footprint. The uniform reference thickness used for 2D stiffness, volume, and compliance is not stated.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit reference thickness, t_ref=1",
        "Explicit reference thickness, t_ref=0.1"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Cantilever supports",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2 delegates the boundary-condition setup to unavailable Fig. 1. Neither the supported boundary nor its supported portion is specified in prose. Here L=20 and H=10 denote the inferred footprint.",
      "readings": [
        "Support the entire left edge, x=0 and 0≤y≤H",
        "Support only the two left corners, (0,0) and (0,H)",
        "Support left-edge patches with y/H in [0,0.1] and [0.9,1]"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_type",
      "entity": "Displacement constraints at the supported end",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The cantilever label identifies a restrained end, but Sec. 2 and Fig. 1's caption do not specify the actual constrained displacement components.",
      "readings": [
        "Set ux=uy=0 at every supported node",
        "Restrain ux along the supported edge and restrain uy at one reference node, allowing transverse contraction elsewhere"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Applied cantilever load",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The load location is part of the setup referred to Fig. 1; no coordinates or relative position appear in the text.",
      "readings": [
        "Right-edge midpoint, x/L=1 and y/H=0.5",
        "Lower-right corner, x/L=1 and y/H=0",
        "Upper-right corner, x/L=1 and y/H=1"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial distribution of the applied load",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Eq. (1) introduces boundary traction t0, but the Fig. 1 reference supplies no accessible specification of loaded nodes, loaded length, or traction profile.",
      "readings": [
        "One concentrated nodal force",
        "Uniform traction over the entire free edge",
        "Uniform traction over a segment of length 0.1H centered at the load position",
        "Two equal simultaneous nodal forces at the free-edge corners"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Direction of the applied load",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 2 nor Fig. 1's caption gives components or an angle for t0.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical downward load, proportional to (0,-1)",
        "Horizontal axial load, proportional to (-1,0)",
        "Oblique load, proportional to (1,-1)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Applied force or traction amplitude",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No numerical magnitude is assigned to t0 in Eq. (1), Sec. 2, Table 1, or Fig. 1's caption. Reported compliance values do not uniquely recover it.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalize the total resultant force to F=1",
        "Use total resultant force F=0.001"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Non-design material near supports and loads",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 and Table 1 do not explicitly identify passive regions or state that none exist; the generic density bounds do not describe any support or load pads.",
      "readings": [
        "All cells are designable; no passive regions",
        "Fix a one-cell solid pad around the loaded node",
        "Fix solid cells along the supported edge and around the load"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Reference volume and accounting for passive material",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The fraction 0.3 is explicit, but Eq. (1) does not define V0 or explain how any fixed solid regions enter the volume budget.",
      "readings": [
        "V0 is the full rectangular reference volume; fixed solid material counts toward the 0.3 budget",
        "V0 is the designable-region reference volume; fixed solid regions are excluded from both numerator and denominator",
        "Reserve fixed solid material first, then allow 0.3 of the remaining designable volume"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Density field used in the volume constraint",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. (1) uses rho for design variables, stiffness, and volume before Sec. 2 introduces filtering. It does not explicitly map the baseline's raw and filtered fields into the volume calculation.",
      "readings": [
        "Use filtered density for stiffness and raw design density for volume",
        "Use filtered density for both stiffness and volume"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional elastic constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Table 1 gives linear elasticity, E=1, and mu=0.3, but does not state whether the sheet is analyzed under plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic plane stress, interpreting mu as Poisson's ratio 0.3",
        "Isotropic plane strain, interpreting mu as Poisson's ratio 0.3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finest element size",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 2 writes h4=1×0.5^4=0.06125. The formula instead gives 0.0625, which also matches Remark 1's 320×160 grid over the inferred 20×10 footprint.",
      "readings": [
        "Follow the dyadic formula and stated uniform grid: h4=0.0625",
        "Follow the printed numerical size: target h4=0.06125, requiring a different grid or extent"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Displacement finite elements and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 supplies cell counts and refinement levels, but neither it nor Table 1 specifies displacement interpolation order or stiffness quadrature. Naming deal.II does not select these.",
      "readings": [
        "Bilinear Q1 quadrilaterals with 2×2 Gauss integration",
        "Biquadratic Q2 quadrilaterals with 3×3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Helmholtz equation and radius convention",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Table 1 fixes the reported radius at 0.375, but Sec. 2 gives no PDE defining how that radius enters the Helmholtz operator.",
      "readings": [
        "Solve filtered_rho - r² Laplacian(filtered_rho) = raw_rho with r=0.375",
        "Treat 0.375 as an equivalent geometric radius and use Helmholtz coefficient r²/12"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "PDE filter boundary conditions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 names the Helmholtz filter but supplies no boundary conditions or exterior-density extension.",
      "readings": [
        "Homogeneous Neumann conditions on the entire domain boundary",
        "Zero-density Dirichlet conditions on the entire domain boundary",
        "Extend the filtering domain with fixed-void padding outside the design rectangle"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "PDE filter discretization and density transfer",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No filter finite-element space, mass-matrix treatment, or mapping between elemental design densities and the filter field is specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Nodal Q1 finite-element Helmholtz solve with a consistent mass matrix and cell-average filtered outputs",
        "Nodal Q1 filter with mass lumping and cell-center sampling",
        "Cell-centered finite-difference Helmholtz filter on the structured grid"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "GOCM exponential update and step interpretation",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Table 1 supplies the step schedule and calls the update exponential, but Sec. 2 provides no update equation or explicit relationship between step length, damping, and move bounds.",
      "readings": [
        "Use the listed step length as damping in a multiplicative exponential GOCM update, without an additional move bound",
        "Use the exponential update with an absolute density move bound equal to the listed, decaying step length"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Volume multiplier solve accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The GOCM description does not specify the numerical tolerance for finding the volume-constraint multiplier or satisfying the volume budget during updates.",
      "readings": [
        "Solve the multiplier to relative volume error 0.001",
        "Solve the multiplier to relative volume error 1e-8"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Meaning of the density change in the stopping criterion",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. (2) calls Delta_rho_e the density change without defining an absolute value. Its weighted sum can therefore mean materially different convergence tests.",
      "readings": [
        "Volume-weighted mean of absolute element changes: sum(v_e |rho_new-rho_old|)/sum(v_e)",
        "Absolute value of the volume-weighted signed mean change",
        "Literal signed volume-weighted mean change"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Elasticity and filter linear-solve accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 and Table 1 give no residual tolerances for the state or Helmholtz solves, despite specifying a stiffness floor of 1e-9.",
      "readings": [
        "Direct solves to near floating-point precision",
        "Iterative solves with relative residual tolerance 1e-8",
        "Iterative solves with relative residual tolerance 1e-12"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
